text.body:
(ifp transcript 1061) || {caturvedārthatātparyasaṅgrahaḥ} ||
yasmai namo bhavati yasya guṇāḥ samagrāḥ nārāyaṇopaniṣadā yadupāsanoktam | yo naḥ pracodayati buddhimarikṣatau ya(-) staṃ tvāmananyagati īśvara saṃśrayāmi || 1 ||
vedeṣu vā tadanuyāyiṣu vā vicārya tantreṣu vākyamakhilaṃ pratipādakaṃ te | tātparyasaṃgrahamahaṃ vidadhe (?) mahyaṃ prasīda naya māmṛjunā pathātvam || 2 ||
mantrārthavādavidhibhirbahudhā vibhakto yaḥ śabdarāśiranapekṣatayā pramāṇam | so'yaṃ vimatsaravimṛṣṭaparārthatattvo vedaḥ prakāśayati kevalamīśvaraṃ tvām || 3 ||
śabdo'yamīśvara iti śrutigocaraḥ sa(-) nnānīlakaṇṭhamavataṃsitacandrarekham | tvāmeva bodhayati nātha nijārthapoṣā(-) danyaṃ punaḥ prakaraṇādinipīḍanena || 4 ||
śabdastavāyamabhidhānamananyaśabdo naighaṇḍukāśśivapadādivadenamāhuḥ | vastusvabhāvakṛtameva tu pūjyabhāvaṃ brūte maheśvara mahānparamaśca śabdaḥ || 5 ||
yasyopasarjanamasau paramo mahān vā śabdastadarthamabhidhātumalaṃ prakṛṣṭam | śabdena pūjyavacanena samāsyamānaṃ pūjāṃ bravīti yadi śabdavidaḥ pramāṇam || 6 ||
nānīśvaraṃ bhavitumarhati viśvametat bāhyeśvaraṃ ca nitarāmayathāpramāṇam | tallokavedaviditeśvaravarjanena ko'yaṃ bhramaḥ katicidīśvaramanyamāhuḥ || 7 ||
viśvaṃ nirīśvaramidaṃ jagadāha sāṃkhyo yogaśca seśvaramubhāvanuvādino'nye | natveva sambhavati seśvaratāṃ bruvāṇāḥ padmāsanādibhiranīśvaraśabdavācyaiḥ || 8 ||
aiśvaryamagryamanapāyinabandhanaṃ te yadbhūtaramyanamasāmasi pātramekam | tatprāyaśaḥ śrutiṣu durlabhameva vākyaṃ muktvā namo bhavati yatra tava prasaṅgam || 9 ||
deva tvadekaviṣayāṇi namāṃsi puṃsāṃ yasmai namaḥ śrutibalādavadhārayāmaḥ | devāntareṣu vihitānyapi tānyamuni srotāṃsi sāgara iva tvayi saṃpatanti || 10 ||
yasmai namaśrśrutiranūdya namasvinaṃ tvā(-) mekā niyojanamuvāca paśoḥ kapardin | anyā ca divyaśiśumāraśiśo bhavantaṃ śakyaṃ taditthamubhayena namo vidhātum || 11 ||
śrutyordvayorapi namasvinamuccamānaṃ tvāmeva taṃ tamanusaṃdadhataḥ pradeśam | śaṃsanti mandamatayo'pi kimāpatantaṃ madhyandine'pi savitāramapahnuvīran || 12 ||
karmaiva śūladhara śūlagavaṃ tvadīya mantrā bhavantamakhilāḥ pratipādayanti | tvāmantareṇa namasā kṛtalakṣaṇāya kasmai paśuṃ niyujāma mayājayatvam || 13 ||
aṅgāntareṣu vibudhāntarasaṃskṛteṣu yaḥ śiṃśumāraśirasāḥ pariśiṣyase tvam | tasmai namo bhavitumīśvara sāmpramaṃ te devāntarāya na kathañcidanīśvarāya || 14 ||
yā vajriṇī bhavati śaṅkaraśaṅkhinī yā mudrā ca yā kamalinī bharatopadiṣṭā | tābhirbhavantyabhinayā vibudhāntarāṇāṃ maulispṛśā karapuṭāñjalimudrayā te || 15 ||
dattaṃ namaḥ kimapi śuśruma devatābhi(-) stvāmantareṇa namasāmavasānabhūmim | tāstadgrahītumanalaṃ na hi kiñcidiṣṭe coropanītamiva dhārayituṃ kirīṭam || 16 ||
tasmai namo bhavati yatra niṣīdasīti sarvaṃ namasyamanayā tu diśā maheśa | ādyoṣadhaṃ prati namo vayamāmanāmo dehīva dehamadhi(ti) ṣṭhasi yena sarvam || 17 ||
sarvaṃ tvayā jagadadhiṣṭhitameva matvā śvānaśrutau namasi tāḥ patayaśca teṣām | loke punastava maheśvarabhaktiyogā(-) dāropitā api vayaṃ bahumānapātram || 18 ||
dvedhā namo vimṛśataḥ pratibhāti loke vedeṣu vā viṣamalocananānyarūpam | yattannamastvayi tadīśvaratāprayuktaṃ tatsannikarṣavihitaṃ yadi nīśvareṣu || 19 ||
tvatsannikarṣakṛta eva namaḥ prayogaḥ prāyo varīyasi yavīyasi dṛśyamānaḥ | śraiṣṭhyaprayuktamiti kalpayituṃ na śakya(-) maśreyasāmasi namāṃsi nidarśitāni || 20 ||
śraiṣṭhyaprayuktamapi nāma namastvadīyaṃ śreṣṭhyāsi yaḥ kratubhujāṃ patiraghniyānām | śraiṣṭhiśruto'si bhagavannaviśeṣatastvaṃ mantreṣu kṛcchrapaṭhiteṣu ca sāmagānām || 21 ||
devāntaraiḥ saha namaskṛtibhūtayaste toṣāya nālamalameva viparyayāya | putrārthinaśca (ścaru) ruruvidhau saha candramaule somena hūtamanuśuśruma rudramagnim || 22 ||
agniṃ prakṛtya khalu rudrapadaṃ prayuṅkte tadbrāhmaṇaṃ bhavati tayoḥ sahūtiḥ | āhvānamatra bhavataḥ pṛthageva dṛṣṭaṃ yatprātaragnimiti sūktavidaḥ paṭhanti || 23 ||
agnyādibhiḥ saha maheśvarabhūtiśaṅkā mābhūditi prakṛtimapyanuṣaṅgayogyam | mantraḥ kriyāpadamapāsya padāntareṇa tvāmāhvayantu tapade na bhinatti rītim || 24 ||
nyāsīkṛto vasubalādamarairavāstu(-) mahnāgato ruditavāniti rudramagnim | rudrāṃ svadudbhavatayā maruto gaṇān vā rudrāvaro na ca bhavantamavaimi rudram || 25 ||
yajñe'pi rudrapadamāruṇaketukoktaṃ tacchabdamīśvara tadīśvara tadīyamapi smaranti | yattatpradeśagatarudrapadāvakāśe yajñasya śabdamanuśuśruma sāmagebhyaḥ || 26 ||
santāpya rodayitari prasabhaṃ ca nānā(-) māhurjvare'pi viṣamekṣaṇarudraśabdam | raudraṃ ca tatprakṛtikaṃ pratirūpakaṃ vā śabdāntaraṃ bhavati vāyasaśabdakalpam || 27 ||
santyeva taddhitayadapratirūpakāṇi bhūrīṇi bhāvata sāttvatasannibhāni | syāttādṛgeva bhagavāniti śabdarūpaṃ ṣāḍguṇyahetukriyadravi(mapi)tvadupaiti nānyam || 28 ||
aiśvaryamagayamanapāyimatī ca lakṣmī jñānaṃ ca vīryayaśasī ca virāgatā ca | ete guṇādhipate bhagasaṃjñayoktā saṃsanti no na bhagavan bhagavānasi tvam || 29 ||
aiśvaryamīśvarapadaśrutirudraśabdo vīryaṃ yaśaḥ śivapadaṃ ca tavābhidhatte | sarvajñakāmaripuśabdasamarthitau ca sarvajñarāgavirahau bhavataḥ purāre || 30 ||
arthakriyā śiva na ko'pi virajyataste śreṣṭhastathā tvamasi dāśatayī riktam | labdhuṃ śriyaṃ munimacāri vicitrarūpa(-) mabhyarcitaṃ tava marudbhirudāharanti || 31 ||
satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiradhiṣṭhatirātmabodhaḥ(-) sṛṣṭirvirāgatapasīmatirīśvaratvam | na tvadviyanti na kadācidapaiti dharmaḥ kiṃ tanna yadbhavati te guṇasaṃmateṣu || 32 ||
naiveśvarānna yaśā mahato na vīrā(-) nna śrīmataḥ kṣitipatīnapi sārvabhaumān | anyādṛśānapi maheśvara vītarāgān prajñāvato bhagavataḥ pravadanti buddhāḥ || 33 ||
atharvaṇā madanaśāsananibruvāṇā nāmāni nāma bhagavāniti te nirāhuḥ | atyāśramopaniṣadāha bhageśvaraṃ tvāṃ naikhaṇḍukāśca bhagavantamuśanti pūjyam || 34 ||
pūjā tamuṣṭuhivatā vihitā maheśa mantreṇa vāṅmanasakāyanibandhanā te | sarvābhirapyupaniṣadbhirupāsanoktā nārāyaṇopaniṣadaṃ paribhāvayāmaḥ || 35 ||
vākyaṃ yadāha daharāntarupāsanaṃ te yadvā samaṃ pacati rūpaviśeṣamasmai | antargatairapi tadaupayikābhidheyai(-) rgopyaṃ vacobhiriti vākyavidāṃ pravādaḥ || 36 ||
nārāyaṇasya yadupāsyatayābhidhānaṃ yadvā phalaṃ tadiha nopalabhe kathañcit | utpattiśiṣṭabhavadanayamanyagāmi śakyaṃ maheśvara na kartumupāsanaṃ te || 37 ||
nāsāvupāsanamupāsyakathaiva dūre tasmā upāsakatayā pariśeṣasiddhaḥ | antarvyavasthitagirā paramātmanaste śabdādṛte'pi vihitaṃ tadupāsakatvam || 38 ||
yasya sthito'pi hṛdaye para(ma)stvamātmā yattanna tasya paramātmatayābhidhānam | svena svayaṃ manasi vahniśikhāntarāle tiṣṭhantūpāsya iti hāsyapadaṃ na kasya || 39 ||
nārāyaṇaprakaraṇe hṛdayaṃ yaduktaṃ tasyaiva tadbhavitumarhati nāparasya | dṛṣṭā yatiprakaraṇe yatibhirgṛhītaṃ pūrvānuvākavihitaṃ yadupāsanaṃ te || 40 ||
brahmocyate paramasau paramaṃ ca tattvaṃ jyotiḥ paraṃ ca parameśvara padmanābhaḥ | tvadbhāvanaikarasikastvadananyabhāvā mantrī yathā garuḍabhāvanayā garutmān || 41 ||
gītāsu yogajavibhūtivibhāvanāya nārāyaṇaḥ śivanaraṃ prati vācamūcai | yogaṃ niśāmaya maheśvaragocaraṃ me divyaṃ dadāmi tava cakṣuriti prasannaḥ || 42 ||
tvāmantareṇa na kathañcidupāsanīya(-) manyaṃ bravīti saśivastutirandhakāre | yadbrahmaśabdasamabhivyavahārayogāt saṃhārakāriṇi hare śivaśabdamāhuḥ || 43 ||
viśvādhikastvamasi viśvamayaṃ murāri(-) ryajñeśvarastvamasi yajñamamuṃ gṛṇanti | ādyā jagatprakṛtireṣa bhavānimittaṃ mātaḥ kathaṃ nu yuvayorbhagavannabhedaḥ || 44 |
viśvātmanastutiṣu viśvapatitvavādaḥ saṃgacchate stuti tayaiva rathāṅgapāṇeḥ | viśvasya patyuratha viśvatayābhimānaṃ nālaṃ guṇāya guṇagṛhyanikarṣahetuḥ || 45 ||
viśvaṃ maheśvara bhavānadhitiṣṭhatīti viśvātmatāmupacaranti yadāgamāste | tatpaṇḍitā viditavedarahasyaśīlā jānanti mūḍhamatayastu tadeva satyam || 46 ||
tubhyaṃ namo vidadhadīśvara taṃ tamartha(-) mātiṣṭhate sakalakarmasu sarvadarśī | sarvānuvākamamimuktasamarthanāya kātyāyano munirudāharati sma gṛhye || 47 ||
sthānaṃ yadantaramupāstirupāsako vā yā sā tathā paratayā vividhānibhūtiḥ | yadvā punarviṣamanetramupāsitavyaṃ nārāyaṇopaniṣadāha tadatra sarvam || 48 ||
yajñātmanā svayamasāvṛṣiṇopadiṣṭā nārāyaṇena bhavatā pratipādayitrī | sūktaṃ yathā puruṣadaivatamantakāre nārāyaṇārṣamiti tadvyapadiṣṭamāhuḥ || 49 ||
eṣā mahopaniṣadāha hiraṇyagarbhaṃ jātaṃ tvadeva bhagavan prathama surāṇām | nārāyaṇābhijanamena mandāḥ śaṃsanti tatra bhavataśca tataḥ prasūtim || 50 ||
madhye lalāṭamaravindabhuvakṣaṇena dṛṣṭo bhavāniti ka eṣa nikarṣavādaḥ | yogādhirūḍhamanasaśśiva mādṛśo'pi sthāneṣu pañcasu na kasya tavopalambhaḥ || 51 ||
brahmāṇi pañcatanavastava mantrarūpān jīvātavaḥ paśupateḥ śivasaṃhitānām | rudreṣu puṇyamiva pañcakamakṣarāṇā(-) masyāṃ mahopaniṣadīti mahattvavādaḥ || 52 ||
vidyeśvarastvamasi bhūtapatistvamekaḥ sraṣṭā bhavānadhipatiḥ sṛjati prapañcam | yadbrāhmaṇān prati tava śrutamādhipatyaṃ tadbrāhmaṇo mama sadā śivajanmalābhaḥ || 53 ||
vidyeśvara kva punaruktatayā na vācyaṃ vedādhipatyamayameva maheśa vedāt | vidyā bhavanti śataśaḥ pravibhajyamānā srotāṃsi nīrasarideva pṛthakkṛtāni || 54 ||
ādityamṛgyajuṣasāmanidhānakośe bimbe niviṣṭamadhitiṣṭhati pauruṣo yaḥ | eṣā tameṣa iti sābhinayā bhavantaṃ bhūtādhipatyavacanena śaśāṃsanāmnā || 55 ||
ukto hiraṇyapatireṣu hiraṇyabāhu(-) ruktāmbikāpatirumāpatireṣa uktaḥ | āhurbhavantamadhidaivatamuṣṇaraśme(-) rātastvadarcanavidhau bhagavannabhijñāḥ || 56 ||
yo maṇḍalaṃ tapati yaśca tadantarātmā yā cānayorbhavati bhūtapatervibhūtiḥ | jānāna etadapi yatphalamaśnute ca sarvaṃ yathāvadiha tatkathituṃ krameṇa || 57 ||
mānāma bhūdakhilamanyadimaṃ pradeśa(-) madhyāpitāstaditi mantravido vadanti | vācyaṃ kramasya savitā saviturvareṇyaṃ kiṃ vā bhavāniti hi tarkapadena teṣām || 58 ||
bhāsvantameṣa viṣayīkurute na mantraḥ śaknoti vaktumadhidaivatamīśvaraṃ tvām | yasmādayaṃ tvayi nirohati bhargaśabdaḥ prajñāpya codakatayā yadadhīyase tvam || 59 ||
sānto'yamantakaripo yadi bhargaśabdo yattatpadadvayamananvayiliṅgabhedāt | anveṣayedabhayadanyadabhinnaliṅga(-) maśrūyamāṇamasamañjasa eva pakṣaḥ || 60 ||
śabdasmṛterasuni vā ghañi vā padānte yuktaṃ vadatyubhayathā svaramādyudāttam | vinyastakārakamavaimi padaṃ ghañantaṃ maitrāyaṇaśrutiparāhatasāntabhāvam || 61 ||
maitrāyaṇaśrutirasau taditi prakṛtya bhargaṃ bhavantamabhidhāya vicintanīyam | rudrasya bhargapadagocaratāṃ bruvāṇā sāntaṃ pratikṣipati bhargapadaṃ purāreḥ || 62 ||
sāntaṃ padaṃ tadapi naiva dadāti vaktuṃ yadbrāhmaṇaṃ talavakāriṇamāmananti | praśnottarakramanirūpitapūrvapādaṃ pādastadīyamatha bhargamayaṃ bravīti || 63 ||
bhargaḥ pracodayati yo dhiyamasmadīyān taṃ dhīmahīti ghaṭanā vinimāpya liṅgam | vācyasya bhagavata svapadābhidhānaṃ bhargasyamityapi ca sāmbavaco nirodhaḥ || 64 ||
tvāmeva mantropaniṣadbravīti tadityṛco'syāḥ pratipādyamartham | tadakṣaraṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ prajñā ca tasmāt prasṛteti śabdaiḥ || 65 ||
bhargo'pi san savitṛśabdasamanvayena sāvitratāmapi vigāhata eṣa mantraḥ | tattatpadadvayavaśena maheśamantraṃ taddevatānapi hi mantravidaḥ paṭhanti || 66 ||
apyarkadaivatimṛcamāmanāma śabdena viśva iti śaṅkaravaiśvadevīm | pitryaṃ ca matta iti puṣyapadopaniṣṇā(-) metādṛśāni kati nāma ni (**) tāni || 67 ||
eṣā gatiḥ śrutigirāmiti nirṇayena tattadgṛhārcanavidhau munayaḥ smaranti | mantreṇa śaṅkara śanaiḥ samupakrameṇa budhyasva śabda na hi tena budhasya pūjām || 68 ||
āmnāyamṛgyajuṣasāmanidhiṃ vicintya sāraṃ samuddhṛtavatā parameṣṭhināpi | mantra (***) dayamadṛṣṭayāntareṇa dṛṣṭaścarācaraguro manunā yathoktam || 69 ||
gṛhṇātu kāmamanassakalaṃ haviste rājño balaṃ haratu bhāgadughaḥ prajābhyaḥ | pārthena śaṅkara niveditumambujākṣe(-) naiśaṃ hi visphuṭamadṛśyata pādayoste || 70 ||
(**) tvadarthamanuśuśruma sūyamāna(-) mālambhanaṃ paśupate niyataṃ paśūnām | gavyaṃ ca tena gavi sadeva tadadhvareṣu caṇḍeśvareṇa saha nākasatāṃ vivādaḥ || 71 ||
utpattitaḥ śivagṛhītasamanvayāste somaḥ paśurgavi ca santi havīṃṣi yāni | devāḥ (**) pa viṣi bhāgamanujñayā te gṛhṇanti tadvaditareṣu vikalpanīyam || 72 ||
karmaikameva na paraṃ paśubandhanaṃ te kartavyamāharupalabhya tavābhyanujñām | sarveṣu karmasu bhavatprasavena puṃsā(-) mārambhaṇaṃ prapadamantravido gṛhṇanti || 73 ||
saṃkalpitaḥ prabhṛti (*) ṣṭatanuṃ vibhajya devān prajāpatimukhān pratidarśayantaḥ | somāhutiṃ hutavahārciṣi hūyamāna(-) madhvaryavastava gṛṇanti giriśabhāgam || 74 ||
sarvaṃ dhanaṃ dhanapaterupabhuktaśiṣṭaṃ yaddevatātithisamāśritabhṛtyavargaiḥ | yajñeśayajñapariśiṣṭamapi tvadīyaṃ maṇḍi(?) grahiṣyati kare bhavatā yathoktam || 75 ||
gavyena somahaviṣā carubhiśca pakvai(-) ryān saptasaptamunayo vibhajanti yajñān | sarveṣu teṣvadhibhavānaviśeṣatastvāṃ rājānamadhvaravidhau vayamāmanāmaḥ || 76 ||
agniṃ prakāśayatu śaṅkararudravantaṃ mantrastvamagna iti vā tadanantaro vā | rājanvatikṣitiritīva viśeṣaṇasya nālaṃ pradīpamapanetumimau prakarṣam || 77 ||
yā rohiṇī bhavati devatayā tvadīyāṃ tasyāṃ tvadekaviṣayau viṣamākṣadṛṣṭau | mantrāvimau tadiha yajñapatistvamīśa spaṣṭaṃ tvadekaviṣayaṃ pratiyanti dhīrāḥ || 78 ||
pitrā kumāramiva bhṛtyamiveśvareṇa śiṣyaṃ girīśaguruṇeva guṇādhikena | agniṃ tvayā kṛtaviśeṣaṇamūcivāṃsau mantrāvimau gamayataḥ paramaṃ prakarṣam || 79 ||
ṛksaṃhitā vadati meyapatiṃ bhavantaṃ rājānamadhvaravidherayamāha mantraḥ | tvatsūktamantragaṇimaṇḍanamauliratnaḥ rūpeṇa vatvadabhidhānagṛhītaśaktiḥ || 80 ||
tvatkaṃ purā maraṇatasnuyirtu (*) kalpā(-) dākāraṇaṃ paramakāruṇikaṃ bruvāṇāḥ | mantro'yamāva iti yāvadupakramāyā mūlaṃ maheśaviditaṃ śivadharmasūkteḥ || 81 ||
bhīmo'si śaṅkaramṛgo na nidarśanaṃ te tejobhiraccalitasūryasahasrakalpaiḥ | akrodhanasmi(ta)mukho'pi nijānubhāvā(-) dāpātatastanubhṛtāṃ nṛpatirbhayāya || 82 ||
abhyudyataṃ giriśavajramadhīmahe tvā(-) ntvajībibhyataḥ pavanabhānukuśānuśakrāḥ | mṛtyuśca tattadadhikārabhṛtastathānye brahmatvalakṣaṇamayaṃ bhayahetubhāvāḥ || 83 ||
ghorā śivā ca bhagavan tu bhayistanuste ghorābhiṣajyati bhavān tadupāsyamān | anyā bhiṣakjanakṛtāṃ mṛjamikṣamāṇā dṛṣṭyā dadāti śivātmano'pi || 84 ||
ghorānnamo vidadhataḥ śamayanti rudrai(-) rārtā hi ghoramupayānti cikitsitā (*) m | pṛṇanti śaṅkaraśivaṃ ca makānuvākai(-) homasya yattava bhavantyubhaye'pi mantrāḥ || 85 ||
viṣṇuprajāpatipurandarapūrvakeṣu vājāditulyamitareṣvapi daivateṣu | āśaṃsiteṣu camakāḥ pariśiṣyamāṇaṃ dātāramīśvarabhavantamaśabdamāhuḥ || 86 ||
yuktaṃ na mā nayitumīśvarasannidhau te devāntarāṇi mahatāmiva martyamātram | antarddhimadhvaravidhau tadapekṣamāṇā(-) stvatkarmasīmni pariṣecanamācaranti || 87 ||
ātmāntarāṇi paśavaḥ paratantrabhāvāt svātantryataḥ paśupateḥ patirīśvaratvam | ātmānamanāpaniṣadāḥ pravadantyanīśa(-) mīśaṃ bhavantamubhayorubhayaṃ svabhāvaḥ || 88 ||
saṃprāpta eva sati śaṅkarapāśupatye kasmai vareṇyavaraṇaṃ kṛpaṇocitaṃ te | vidhyarthamadhyayanacodanayā gṛhītā jāpanti yatkimapi paṅktivadarthavādāḥ || 89 ||
nānāvadānavacanādapi vāraṇīya(-) stvatpāśupatyavaraṇaṃ pratilambhavādaḥ | labdhuṃ varītumathavā kathameka eva pārān bahūnapi maheśvara śakyate'rthān || 90 ||
aṅge sthire'pi ritirūpamanīśvaraṃ te bhūrīṇi tāni ca bhujaṅgamamālahārin | mantreṇa cāntariti yuṣmadupāsakānā(-) māśvedakāyadaśanaṃ tadamoghamāhuḥ || 91 ||
bhāvopapannamanasāṃ tvadupāsakānāṃ puṃsāmamoghamaśanaṃ bhagavan bruvāṇaḥ | mantro'yamantariti naḥ pratibhāti mūlaṃ prāgbhuktamarcanavidheranuvāsaraṃ te || 92 ||
nātha tvayā pitṛmato maritastuvānā(-) stvāmāmananti bharataṃ naṭanābhiyogāt | vaiśeṣike khalu sati vyapadeśahetau sādhāraṇena bharaṇena na kaścidarthaḥ || 93 ||
hiṃsāpratītirabhimānapadaikadeśa riti padena tadvapanti | kāmāntakatripuradakṣamakhādibhaṅga(-) vikhyātavikramatayā kathito'si vīraḥ || 94 ||
hiṃsābhidhātṛpadasannidhinājya(-) rudreti nāma pa (*) śaṅkyaparāpavantaḥ | mantre yathāgna iti maṅgalavāci dṛṣṭa(-) deveśarudriyapadaṃ punarāvapanti || 95 ||
śākhāsu śaṅkara sahasratayīṣu sāmnā(-) māmnāyate tava na kevalamānubhāvaḥ | sarvātmanāmadhipateraviśeṣataste devavratādiṣu gaṇaḥ kathito'nubhāvāḥ || 96 ||
skandaṃ vināyakamubhāvapi te kumārau sarvairgaṇaiḥ pitarameva nidarśayantau | sāmopakāyamukhagāyamṛcāṃ gaṇeṣu saṃprīṇayanti śivasāmavidhau yathoktam || 97 ||
brahmādikraṃ sakalamanyadapohya puṃsāṃ dhyātavyamekamabhidhāya śivaṃ karaṃ tvām | vaktavyamanyadanapekṣya vimokṣahetu(-) māyā(tha)rvaṇaṃ parisamāptimuvāca vedaḥ || 98 ||
yāmāmananti tava śaṅkaradharmadārā(-) nadhvaryavaḥ sahajasiddhatayā svasāram | atharvaṇāyamupasṛṣṭatayā bhavantaṃ dhyātavyamāhurapahāya pitāmahādīn || 99 ||
ekaśruto'si parameśvara sadīnidhāma(-) mantrā yathā vyapadiśanti punaḥ punastvām | tasyāḥ prabhāvamativācyamanasaṃ śivāyāḥ kastyena vaktumanalaṃ kamalāsano'pi || 100 ||
ekaṃ mukhaṃ tritayamīśvaralocanānāṃ catvāri doṣi viśadaṃ vapuradbhūtaṃ te | nityaṃ tadeva jagatāmupakāraheto nānā bhavanti tanavastava divyarūpāḥ || 101 ||
kairātamīśvarapinākadharaṃ vapuste kṛtyaṃ vasāmumayā saha dharmadāraiḥ | ārādhayanti khalu parvaṇi sākamethe puṇyaistriyambakahavirbhirananyabhāvāḥ || 102 ||
devāṃ samantaviniveśitamindhuṣīka(-) mantarjayantamajarāmaravigrahaṃ tvām | tadvāravandayitayā saha devasenaṃ kṣetrasya nāthamapi nātha yajanti dhanyām || 103 ||
patnyā samaṃ (**) gaṇaiḥ saha vā sutābhyāṃ sārdhaṃ tathā pariṣadā viṣamekṣaṇaṃ tvām | adhyaṣṭamītithiniśāmukhamarcayantaḥ pāpaṃ taranti vijayanti maheśamṛtyum || 104 ||
mantrā bhavanti viralā vibudhāntarāṇāṃ sadbhāva eva śivadarśitaśaktayaste | tvannāmarūpaguṇavarṇanalabdhavarṇā mantrā na śakyamavagantumiyattayā te || 105 ||
rudrānuvākapatakāni parasahasraṃ nāmāni divyamapi rūpamanekaśaste | śakyaṃ guṇāguṇayituṃ na guṇā yadi syāt bhaumeṣu pāṃsuṣu vinā tava devamāyām || 106 ||
vedastvatha bhavi kṛpāṃ tava vā praṇītiḥ sarvaḥ pramāṇamavihāya gṛṇāti lokaḥ | tattatpravaktṛguṇadarśitatāratamya(-) manyatpramāṇamavirodhini vedavākye || 107 ||
vedāḥ pramāṇamiti saṃgiramāṇa eva divyaṃ tavāgamamavaiti janaḥ pramāṇam | tvaddhyānavākyaviṣayaupayikaiḥ padārthai(-) rāmūrdhamākalitavigrahamā ca mūlāt || 108 ||
dhyānaṃ yathā bhavati tadviṣayo yathākaṃ yā durguṇaśca bhagavānadhikārivargaḥ | sarvāṇi tāni bhavadāgamasaṃhitābhiḥ kalpairivādhvaravidherupapāditāni || 109 ||
adhvānamadhvapatimadhvani tāratamyaṃ śreṣṭhādhvapāragamanaṃ capalaṃ bravīti | mantro'dhvanāmiti maheśvaragṛhyakāraḥ pitrā kumāramupanīya yadāha vākyam || 110 ||
kalpāḥ pramāṇamṛṣibhiryadi naḥ praṇītāḥ kinna pramāṇamṛṣiṇāṃ mahatāṃ maharṣe | śakyaṃ na vaktuma (**) grahadūṣitāni tantrāntarāṇi bhavatā śiva kartṛmanti || 111 ||
ācakṣate yajuṣamārṣavidastapobhi(-) rekaikamantradṛśamīśvaravedarāśeḥ | draṣṭāramasya nikhilena nijānubhāvā(-) danyānṛṣīnatimaharṣimato vidustvām || 112 ||
uktaṃ pradhānapuruṣeśvarameva sāṃkhyai(-) rākhyāya pāśapaśupatyabhidhānabhedāt | jetha tvadāgamavidaḥ śivasaṃgiraṃ tā(-) metāvakamiti na stadupekṣaṇīyam || 113 ||
pratyakṣavedavihitaṃ prathitaṃ purāṇaṃ bodhāyanena muninā bahuśaḥ sarvārthadarśanapa (*) rapi gṛhyakārai(-) ryajñopavītamiva vismṛtamarcanaṃ te || 114 ||
vedopabṛṃhakapurāṇavacaḥ prapañcai(-) rāghoṣyate viṣamanetrasamarcanaṃ te | tantrairalaṃ tadupabṛṃhitavedamūlai(-) rvākyāhatannahamukhānilavapyapekṣam || 115 ||
(vedārtha) sanirṇayavidhau hi purāṇamaṅgaṃ nirṇītavedaviṣayā smṛtayo bhavanti | ātaśruteriva purāṇagirissakāśe nālaṃ prakāśayitumātmabalāvalepam || 116 ||
mūlaśruteranupalambhaparāhatāyā dūtīva yā na bhavati svarasātpramāṇam | pratya (*****) taṃ yajanaṃ tvadīyaṃ tasyāḥ smṛterapi kimicchati dṛṣṭipātam || 117 ||
paurvāhṇikānupadiśanniyamān yadeta(-) dabhyarcanaṃ manuravocata devatāyāḥ | tatkiṃ punastava mahatyasi devatā tvāṃ mṛgye'pi kācaśakalena maṇerivo (*) || 118 ||
patnyā samaṃ saha vṛṣeṇa vṛṣendraketo yuṣmadbalīnupadiśaṃ daśāvakāśe | abhyarcanaṃ bhavanakalpanapūrvakaṃ te bodhāyanaḥ kathitayā navayuktya gṛhye || 119 ||
dvedhā tavārcanavidhistaruṇendumaule kāmāya kaścidaparai (***) kṣayāya | apyannahotramubhayaṃ vayamāmanāma svargāya yadbhavati yadduritaṃ kṣiṇoti || 120 ||
yadbrāhmaṇastvamasi nākasadāṃ nikāye tubhyaṃ niveditamabhojyamiti smaranti | ucchiṣṭamīśvaraviśiṣṭamahādvijānāṃ bhūmau nikheyamathavāmbhasi majjanīyam || 121 ||
tvaṃ brāhmaṇastvadupadhāvanameva kāryaṃ tadbrāhmaṇaistuditareṇa bhavantyupāsyāḥ | na brāhmaṇānavaravarṇiniṣevaṇena saṃbhāvayema yadi naḥ prapadaṃ pramāṇam || 122 ||
utkarṣataḥ pariharantyapakarṣato vā kā vāsanā bhavati kasya kṛtena vidmaḥ | yaddīkṣitasya patitasya ca tulyarūpaṃ pratyādiśanti munayaḥ kamanīyamannam || 123 ||
caṇḍālacaṇḍilacitānalaśauṇḍikānāṃ gobrāhmaṇajvalanadīkṣitayoṣitāṃ ca | sparśaḥ kathā bhavati vāsanayā niṣiddha(-) spṛṣṭeṣu vā śivakathā vihitā viśuddhiḥ || 124 ||
varjyānnamāhurapi dīkṣitaṃ śrīkalpamabhojyānnameva kṛtarājaparīkṣayāntam | śaṅkhāsthi pāvanamasti nṛṇāmitthaṃ sthite vacanantraparāyaṇaṃ naḥ || 125 ||
abrāhmaṇaiḥ kṣudapaghātakamastu bhojyaṃ yaddevatāntaraniveditamuktamannam | tadbrāhmaṇairapi kimīśvaravaiśvadeve hāryo balirbalimatāmaśitena tena || 126 ||
teyāntarairaśitamuktamanaṅgarāsi(-) nnaśnanti cedanaśitena baliṃ harantaḥ | āsyaikadeśavihito baliranyathāsaṃ nālaṃ phalāya viparītaphalaṃ ca teṣām || 127 ||
brahmāṇamīśvara purā hatavānasīti bhikṣāṭanaṃ vimṛśataḥ pratihānamātram | yatpañcame śirasi puṣpasamaṃ nikṛtte jīve tamenamamitāyuṣamāhurāptaḥ || 128 ||
ānābhijānavasitaṃ vasannaśāṇaṃ pāṇau kapālaśakalaṃ na vilokitaṃ te | nālambate śivaśivastavaketvayaṣṭau bhaikṣaṃ na saptahavanaṃ sakalaṃ tadāstām || 129 ||
yatkālabhairavakṛtaṃ pata (**) menaḥ kiṃ tena te bhavati bhaikṣamathāpi vṛttiḥ | tanmadhyapātini vidhe vibudhāntarasya nirvedamācarati kiṃ nu bhavānajasram || 130 ||
yatpāśupatyamavṛṇodamarāntarebhyo bhikṣāṃ bhavānakṛta yatparameśvaro'pi | codyaṃ tadetadubhayaṃ parihartukāmo manye bṛhaspatirapi pratipattiśūnyaḥ || 131 ||
brahmāsi viṣṇurasi sarvamasīti yastvā(-) māstāmupāsanavidhiṃ kathayanti mūḍhāḥ | taddevatāntaranikarṣanigūhanāya mohāya vā bhavantu jalpitamalpabuddheḥ || 132 ||
advaitamāgamaśirobhirupāsanāyā(-) muktaṃ taveti paramārthatayā na vācyam | bhedasphuṭo garuḍamāntrikayoralīkaṃ tādātmyabhāvanamathāpi viṣaṃ pramārṣṭiḥ || 133 ||
yadbrahmapañcamaśiro (***) padānaṃ yadbrāhmaṇāśca hariṇā ca vimārgaṇaṃ te | yadvā tayorjanayitāramadhīmahe tvā tatsarvamīśvaravimūḍhadhiyāmasahyam || 134 ||
some latātmani maheśvaragauṇavṛttyā viṣṇoravādijanatvamṛcākayācit | tvayyeva tadbhavitumarhati mukhyavṛttyā nendreṇa paṅkajabhave nitarāṃmurārau || 135 ||
anyonya yadi bhavedahamīśvaraḥ syāṃ tvaṃ vāhamīśvara kimatra niyāmakaṃ na | ko vā viparyasitumarhati vastuśaktiṃ tattatsvabhāvaniyatāṃ bhavatājñayāpi || 136 ||
ekaṃ tavāpyasukaraṃ tadudāharāmo jātena bhāvyama (**) ntaravattvayāpi | aprārthito'pi hi maheśa maharṣidārai(-) rantarhitastvasi garbhitagarbhavāsaḥ || 137 ||
icchāvatīrṇamuraśāsanagarbhavāsaḥ syāccedudāharaṇameṣa vimarśanīyaḥ | garbhe vasāmi pariveṣṭya jarāyuṇāhaṃ māsān bahūniti maheśvara kasya kāmaḥ || 138 ||
icchāpi nūnamanuyāti purākṛtāni karmāṇi śaṅkara śubhāśubhalakṣaṇāni | icchāvatāravacanāni tu bhāratādau nārāyaṇasya guṇavādamudāharanti || 139 ||
vidhātāraṃ kaścidbhajati bhajate kañcana hariṃ surānasyānanye jagati saphalāḥ sarvavidhayaḥ | tathāpi tvadbhakteḥ śiva śiva yadā carmavaditi śruto mantro devāntarabhajanadainyaṃ na sahate || 140 ||
na bhinnā bhinnā nauralamudanidherudgamayituṃ śilā naivonnetuṃ prabhavati śilāmantakaripo | janitvā mṛtvā vā jagati parivartī suragaṇaḥ kathaṃ me saṃsārabhramaṇabhayabhājastu śaraṇam || 141 ||
śaśe śṛṅgaṃ puṣpaṃ nabhasi mṛgatṛṣṇāsu salilaṃ prasūtirvandhyāyāmanavadhimadāyustanubhṛtām | vimuktirvā devāntarabhajanalabhyā paśupate (***) kyaṃ saṃbhāvayitumapi sarvaṃ vimarśatām || 142 ||
devatāntara punaḥ punarbhavaṃ paśyataḥ paśupate bhayaṃ mama | krīḍato'pi mama janmamāsmabhūddīyatāmayamapaścimo varaḥ || 143 ||
(***) parigṛhītadevatā varṇanaupayikasarvavāṅmayam | dhigdhigīśvara (*) rdhāśayaṃ janaṃ tāvakairahamasāni saṅgataḥ || 144 ||
pāṃsukelirapi yasya śaive śaivapāśupatapādapāṃsubhiḥ | stotrakarmaṇi na tasya me guṇa(-) stadguṇo'yamupapadyate tvayi || 145 ||
stotrīyamarthamupapāditavānahaṃ te bhakteti bhaktajanavatsalabhūṣamāṇaḥ | āvirbabhūvitha śikhīḥ śucināmbareṇa yajñopavītamupavītadhṛtaṃ tripuṇḍraḥ || 146 ||
bhaktasivānadita pārśvacaropanītaṃ gṛhyaṃ maheśvarapayaḥ śrapitaṃ prasannaḥ | bhuñjāna eva tadahaṃ tvaditi prabuddhaḥ svapnaḥ samādhiriti yuktadhiyāmabhinnaḥ || 147 ||
stotrameta(da)vadhāya gṛhṇatā(-) marthamasya nikhilena jānajām | grāhyamanyadapi nāvaśiṣyate jñeyamanyadapi vā na kiñcana || 148 ||
pañcāśaduttaraśatā śrutisūktimālā bhogāca(va?)laṃ bhujagarājamanoharā te | vedeṣu saktimaparāgamavaidikeṣu tantreṣu bhaktimatulāṃ tvayi ca prasūte || 149 ||
mithyākalpitabhogamokṣadavacaḥ santānasatyāpana(-) vyagrāṇāmacirā prabhāvavibudhapremṇā maheśadviṣām | mūrdhniṣveva durātmanā viracitāṃ nīrghātapātāḥ parai(-) rvidvadbhiḥ parameśvaraśrutikathātātparyasaṃgrāhakaiḥ || 150 ||
[iti caturvedārthatātparyasaṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ] ||
śrīmaddevaśikhāmaṇigurubhyo namaḥ | śrīmatṣaṇmukhagurave namaḥ | śubhamastu ||
